name: prayer-dome
description: Prayer Dome web app and Android package

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.mobile:build:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:build:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.test: node tests/assistant.test.js && node tests/content.test.js && node tests/academy.test.js && node tests/admin.test.js && node tests/admin-menu.test.js && node tests/admin-auth.test.js && node tests/inline-handlers.test.js && node tests/certificate.test.js && node tests/pages.test.js && node tests/premium.test.js && node tests/challenge.test.js && node tests/certificates.test.js && node tests/devotional.test.js && node tests/geo.test.js && node tests/i18n.test.js && node tests/translate.test.js && node tests/media.test.js && node tests/vercel.test.js && node tests/upgrade.test.js && node tests/icons.test.js && node tests/learning-flow.test.js && node tests/deployment.test.js && node tests/pwa.test.js && node tests/codemagic.test.js && node tests/responsive.test.js && node tests/dev-server.test.js
scripts.lint: node scripts/build-icons.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-production.mjs && python3 seo/apply-seo.py --check
scripts.verify:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run functions:verify
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.31.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-prayer-dome "node tests/rules/firestore.test.js"
